panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Islamic note: riba (رِبَا) is forbidden (Qur'an 2:275: Allah has permitted trade and forbidden riba). Islamic finance uses partnership (mushārakah, مُشَارَكَة) and cost-plus sale (murābaḥah, مُرَابَحَة) instead. Compound interest is on the 4MA1 specification (1.6), so we learn it as knowledge of how the wider economy works, never as something to take.

panels.title: £2,000 grows at 2% a year compound for 3 years.
AB = AC, angle BAC = 40°, BC extended to D. Find angle ACD.
points: Angle ACB = (180 - 40) ÷ 2 = 70° (base angles of an isosceles triangle).
Angle ACD = 180 - 70 (angles on a straight line).
